# jira-start-task


Resolve a Jira issue, ensure the correct branch, generate an OpenSpec prompt, and enrich context using Obsidian MCP for documentation and CodeGraph MCP for structural code analysis.



## Triggers

- usa el skill jira-start-task

- empezar tarea jira

- trabajar en issue

- generar prompt openspec




## What I do

- Resolve the Jira issue from a provided issueKey or by listing open assigned issues

- Fetch issue details (key, title, description) via Jira MCP

- Parse content into structured sections (scenario, acceptance tests, sources, symbols)

- Enrich context with Obsidian MCP documentation search from the vault

- Enrich context with CodeGraph MCP structural code analysis from extracted symbols

- Render and save an OpenSpec prompt ready for execution




## Usage examples

- Empezar una tarea de Jira y generar un prompt OpenSpec con contexto enriquecido

- Trabajar en un issue de Jira con análisis estructural del codebase

- Generar un prompt OpenSpec para un issue de Jira con contexto de Obsidian y CodeGraph
